collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A night watchkeeper wonders whether some distant settlements are so large that work and conversation continue all night.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A night watchkeeper wonders whether some distant settlements are so large that work and conversation continue all night.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Healers, bakers, guards, and travelers populate an imagined city that glows with activity.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A tired watchkeeper asks who protects the workers' rest; the villagers discuss shifts and fatigue.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers theorize about light produced without an open flame, but cannot agree how it would work.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child worries that constant brightness might hide the stars; the astronomer agrees it could change the night.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group concludes that even a huge city might contain quiet rooms and sleeping children.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager who struggles with noise wonders whether quiet could be difficult to find in crowded places.
